title: Every job
caption: The same project plan, one level down: each stage holds its jobs, in the order they depend on each other.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The project-plan Workflow in its Jobs view: every job of every stage as a card, joined by arrows.
readme.tryit: Click a job card to open its stage at exactly that job. Switch back to Stages in the toolbar and compare.
readme.notice: Epics and Execute repeat: each is drawn once, inside a dashed bracket that says it runs once per epic or ticket.
